svg.aria-label: GreenBranch CI/CD. A push to main starts vercel-deploy.yaml when frontend/ changes: it checks the Vercel secrets, then runs vercel pull, vercel build and vercel deploy --prebuilt to production. It starts phone-deploy.yaml when server-ai/, server-runner/ or deploy/phone/ change: the check job installs and imports both backends in parallel and stops the run on any failure; the deploy job then installs cloudflared, configures SSH from secrets, and streams deploy.sh to the phone through Cloudflare Access. On the phone deploy.sh fast-forwards the checkout, syncs dependencies, restarts both backends and waits for /health; if they are not healthy within 60 seconds it resets to the previous commit and fails the run.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: or deploy/phone/ change. One push can start both,
and neither waits for the other.
Both can also be started from the Actions tab.
